tasks.label: compile and run
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "${workspaceFolder}\garbage" | Out-Null; g++ -std=c++17 -o "${workspaceFolder}\garbage\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" "${file}"; if ($?) { Get-Content "${workspaceFolder}\input.txt" | & "${workspaceFolder}\garbage\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" | Out-File -Encoding utf8 "${workspaceFolder}\output.txt" }
